{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.68

|arg= global

|eff= global

|gr1= Weapons

|descr= Enables or disables disassembly of static weapons. Could be applied to local [[player]], to another unit or to static weapon directly.

|s1= [[enableWeaponDisassembly]] enable

|p1= enable: [[Boolean]] - [[false]] to prevent local [[player]] from being able to disassemble static weapons

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|s2= entity [[enableWeaponDisassembly]]  enable

|p21= entity: [[Object]] - unit or static weapon
|p22= enable: [[Boolean]]  - [[false]] to prevent a unit from being able to disassemble static weapons, or to prevent a static weapon from being disassembled by anyone

|r2= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>enableWeaponDisassembly false;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>soldier1 enableWeaponDisassembly false;</sqf>
